note: KDWP state fishing lake off US-54 west of Kingman, beside the Byron Walker Wildlife Area. Primitive camping with no designated or hardened sites, inside the waterfowl refuge on the east side of the lake; picnic tables, fire rings, a group shelter and three vault toilets. Carry out your trash; generators off 11 p.m. to 6 a.m.; no alcohol on the area. Two boat ramps on the east shore, fishing boats at no wake. --Claude
summary: KDWP Kingman page (Wayback 2026-07-11): free, FCFS, no designated or hardened sites, no hookups, no dump, vault toilets, 7 days then 5 away; all groups re-sourced to the agency page, dump false + vault_toilets added. Camping spots not mapped, so waterfront left as stored (lakeview lead). Phone missing -> (620) 532-3242. Pin on the entry road; possible move.
flags: WATERFRONT lead (apply.py doesn't write it): stored 'not waterfront' left alone, unconfirmed. The page says 'No designated sites' and puts 'the campground area' in the refuge on the east side but doesn't map it (the 'Kingman SFL & Byron Walker WA' brochure, https://www.ksoutdoors.gov/home/showpublisheddocument/390/638942133370030000, stayed unread: KDWP 403, Wayback 429). On Esri a dirt track runs the whole east shore from the south ramp to the north toilet, under a 10-25 m band of trees at the water, with pull-ins and fishing piers off it; if that shore track is where people camp it would be LAKEVIEW (filtered through trees) or LAKEFRONT at the open pull-ins. The open grass between the track and the main road is 50-150 m from the water.

PIN 37.65002,-98.2537 is on the main gravel entry road at the south end, beside a dark fenced lot, ~140 m from the water - not on any camping area I can see. KDWP's facilities cluster at the middle of the east shore (Shelter House 37.65443,-98.25658, Middle Toilet 37.65445,-98.25743, Middle Boat Ramp 37.65448,-98.25772) and the south end (South Toilet 37.65107,-98.25520, South Ramp 37.65082,-98.25512). Not moved because the camping area isn't located, but 37.6544,-98.2568 (the shelter / middle-ramp area) would be a better centre if someone can confirm.
